newsitem.title: FINLAND: Orion sees full 1996 better than Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Orion sees full 1996 better than Jan-Aug.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals maker Orion-Yhtyma Oy said on Thursday it expected its full-year profit to improve at a better rate than the 1.9 percent increase in January-August profit to 538 million markka.

"The profit improvement for the whole year 1996 (profit before extraordinary items, voluntary provisions and taxes) is expected to be better than that of the period under review," Orion said in a statement with its January-August results.

"Improved profits will be reached most probably if the U.S. Food and Drug Administration grants market authorisation for the breast cancer drug Fareston in the USA. This would in turn enable milestone payments from the marketing partner and product deliveries," Orion said.
